description: This file contains Polymer framework features, including template preparation, DOM manipulation, content distribution, and custom element registration, primarily for web components using Polymer.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi
classes.description: Provides an abstraction layer over DOM nodes for Polymer, including methods for DOM manipulation, event handling, and node querying.

classes.name: Polymer.EventApi
classes.description: Wraps native DOM events to provide a consistent API for event properties and propagation within Polymer.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi.ClassList
classes.description: A wrapper around the classList property of DOM nodes, allowing class manipulation with automatic content distribution updates.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi.EffectiveNodesObserver
classes.description: Observes changes to effective child nodes, including shadow DOM and content distribution, notifying listeners of changes.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi.DistributedNodesObserver
classes.description: Specialized observer for distributed nodes in shadow DOM, extending EffectiveNodesObserver.

methods.name: _prepTemplate
methods.description: Prepares the template for the element, importing and decorating it as needed.

methods.name: _stampTemplate
methods.description: Instantiates the template content into the DOM.

methods.name: instanceTemplate
methods.description: Creates a clone of the template content.

methods.name: attachedCallback
methods.description: Handles the element's attachment lifecycle, triggering readiness.

methods.name: calculateSplices
methods.description: Calculates differences between current and previous node lists for efficient DOM updates.

methods.name: getInnerHTML
methods.description: Returns the inner HTML of a node, with proper escaping.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Polymer.DomApi instance for a DOM node.

methods.name: hasDomApi
methods.description: Checks if a DOM node has an associated Polymer.DomApi instance.

methods.name: distributeNodeInto
methods.description: Distributes a node into a content insertion point.

methods.name: notifyContentObservers
methods.description: Notifies observers of content distribution changes.
